scope: Unreleased current-scene source draft layout: exact source → shared Rust geometry/history → reviewed coordinate-token patch → in-memory text application → normal editor save.

contracts.sourceMode: Only the current registered scene in the active dirty source editor can receive a reviewed layout patch; fields/blocks and new unregistered scenes cannot.
contracts.geometry: Saved and source-only layouts share the existing Rust position/100-step history session; source-only drafts have no World save command or save-state API.
contracts.patch: Replace changed coordinate scalar ranges only. Preserve untouched source bytes, BOM, CRLF, identity, groups, inheritance and numeric spelling.
contracts.ownership: Preview provenance, source hash, editor/session baseline and origin dialog/scene ownership are checked again after asynchronous preparation and before synchronous memory replacement.
contracts.apply: No filesystem, registry or build write. The editor retains its original expectedVersion and cached disk content. Exact return to baseline clears dirty state and refreshes saved preview.
contracts.externalChange: A disk edit does not prevent a memory-only apply; automatic draft preview can reject its old baseline with 409, and normal Save opens the existing conflict workflow without replacing the external file.
contracts.dependency: JSON CST uses the installed YAML browser ESM; HTTP allows only JavaScript inside that distribution with contained paths, and mobile maps it to the existing vendor/YAML assets.

limitations: HTTP editor and real Chrome canvas only; packaged Tauri IPC and Android were not exercised.
